acceptance.given: A retained evaluation-seed record is submitted for validation.

oracle.expected: Validation rejects the record unless it contains a counterexample or an explicit-absence status.
forbidden: A seed record is accepted without a counterexample.
A seed record is accepted without explicit absence when no counterexample exists.
oracle.observable: The seed-validation result and diagnostic identify missing counterexample/explicit-absence status.

acceptance.then: The retained seed record has either a validated counterexample or an explicit absence and otherwise is rejected.
acceptance.when: The evaluation-seed validator evaluates the retained record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run seed validation against a retained record with both counterexample and explicit-absence fields absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each retained evaluation seed to record a counterexample or explicit absence; reject records missing both.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing seed records remain valid when they contain a counterexample or explicit absence; invalid records fail closed without migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: retained record lacking both fields -> rejected; record with one valid status -> validated
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Seed validation returns a rejection for any record lacking both counterexample and explicit-absence status.

acceptance.given: The rebuilt atomic-obligation graph, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence are available for Exact Cover validation.

oracle.expected: Validation reports zero orphaned atomic obligations and rejects any uncovered obligation.
forbidden: One or more atomic obligations are orphaned.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validation artifact reports an orphan count of zero and identifies bidirectional coverage for every atomic obligation.

acceptance.then: The Exact Cover result contains no orphaned atomic obligations.
acceptance.when: The Exact Cover validator evaluates the complete obligation-to-evidence graph.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run Exact Cover validation with one atomic obligation disconnected from its required evidence mappings.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce bidirectional Exact Cover and reject any graph containing an orphaned atomic obligation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Coverage artifacts remain readable; only orphaned mappings are rejected.

slice_hint.state_transition: unvalidated or orphaned graph -> Exact Cover rejection; fully mapped graph -> zero-orphan result
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact Cover validation completes only when orphan_count equals zero and every obligation has bidirectional mappings.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is evaluated with evidence whose target identity differs from the required target.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid despite wrong-target matrix evidence.
The aggregate is accepted with mismatched target identity.
oracle.observable: The aggregate result records invalid status with a wrong-target diagnostic and no acceptance outcome.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalid and acceptance is blocked.
acceptance.when: Matrix aggregate evaluation verifies target identity bindings for all case evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute aggregate evaluation with matrix evidence bound to a different target than the declared target.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify matrix evidence target identity and invalidate the aggregate on any wrong-target evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing aggregate records remain interpretable; mismatched target bindings produce invalid status.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate with wrong-target evidence -> invalid/non-acceptable aggregate
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate evaluation returns invalid whenever any matrix evidence target identity mismatches the declared target.

acceptance.given: Validator Capability identity and trust inputs are supplied for evaluation.

oracle.expected: Validation rejects any configuration in which the Candidate selects the Validator Capability identity or establishes its trust.
forbidden: The Candidate selects the Validator Capability identity.
Candidate-controlled identity or trust establishes Validator Capability trust.
oracle.observable: The trust-validation result identifies candidate-controlled identity or trust and refuses Validator Capability acceptance.

acceptance.then: Validator Capability identity and trust remain candidate-external; candidate-controlled selection or trust establishment is rejected.
acceptance.when: Validator Capability binding is evaluated before replay execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate a validator capability descriptor whose identity or trust binding is selected or asserted by the Candidate.

affected_subjects: Validator Capability identity and trust binding
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require candidate-external Validator Capability identity and trust binding; reject candidate-controlled selection or self-established trust.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing externally bound validator capability records remain usable; candidate-controlled records are rejected without authority migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate-controlled validator identity/trust -> trust rejection; externally bound capability -> eligible for evaluation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pre-replay trust validation rejects any candidate-controlled Validator Capability identity or trust assertion.
